questions.q: What is the main reason plastic persists in nature?
a: It cannot be broken down by microorganisms
questions.why: Plastic is not biodegradable by microbes.

questions.q: Which animal group would likely thrive if humans vanished?
questions.why: Predators would rise as prey declines.

questions.q: Which building material is mentioned as lasting only a few decades?
questions.why: Glass, steel, and concrete erode in decades.

questions.q: What is the exception to most human creations lasting millennia?
questions.why: The Great Pyramid is noted as an exception.

questions.q: How does weather affect plastic in the environment?
a: It erodes it into smaller pieces
questions.why: Rain, wind, and oceans erode plastic into smaller fragments.
